description: Is this domain available or taken? Check a name across the same 30 extensions the website checks (all 30 by default) using a registered-zone index, live DNS, and the registry's RDAP record. Each row names its status and source, and the answer includes the full results URL. Use check_business_name instead for a complete name check.

name.description: The business, LLC, or trademark name from the conversation. An LLC designator is optional.

tlds.description: Up to 30 top-level domains from the conversation. Omit to check all 30.

name: check_domain_availability
title: Check domain availability
